content: {"summary":"Customers report persistent error messages when attempting to change flights online, causing frustration and repeated failures [#tk_2807753][#tk_2816025][#tk_2815113][#tk_2862802]. Many also note that phone support wait times exceed two hours, making it difficult to resolve issues promptly [#tk_2815960][#tk_2846543][#tk_2859145][#tk_2859187][#tk_2861397]. The inability to cancel or modify reservations via the app or website exacerbates the problem, especially for urgent travel changes [#tk_2851550]. Overall, the spike reflects a breakdown in both digital and call‑center support for flight modifications. "}
